air_switch_specification: Specification of grid side circuit breaker of storage system
aux_contact_tip: The AUX dry contacts can be set to normally open or normally closed, and support working by time or auto-trigger: ON mode: the contacts are closed within the set time and disconnected outside the time. OFF mode: The contact is disconnected within a set time and closed outside the time. AUTO mode: Contacts automatically switch according to system operating conditions (regardless of time setting)
aux_setting_notice1: Note:The feed-in power of switch-on should be more than that of switch-off.
aux_setting_notice2: The contact is only opened/closed if the power fulfills the set conditions for longer than this time.
aux_setting_notice3: After switching on, do not switch off in the given time.
aux_setting_notice4: After switching off, do not switch on in the given time.
backupbox_ready_tip: Currently, only some models are supported. If the system is installed with BackupBox but not used as a grid meter, it is recommended to enable it.
battery_bypass_description: Battery ByPass is an active protection mechanism for the battery system. When an anomaly is detected in a battery (such as abnormal voltage or temperature), it is automatically isolated from the power supply circuit to ensure that other normal batteries continue to operate safely.
battery_free_mode_tip: When turned on, it means that the inverter is on battery-free operation - i.e. regardless of whether there is battery access.
control_mode_tip: Manual control: If this mode is selected, the diesel engine is always on; Time control: When in this mode, please set the diesel engine start time point and a shutdown time point, when the local time is between these two time points, the diesel engine will be turned on; Diesel engine shuts down when local time is outside of these two points in time; SOC control: When in this mode, please set a SOC range, when the SOC of the battery is lower than the lower limit of the SOC range, the diesel engine will be turned on; When the battery SOC is above the upper limit of the SOC range, the diesel engine turns off.
dry_aux_is_on_or_off: The stem node is closed or disconnected
ems_display_lang_tip: The on-device screen shows the language settings
enable_contact_tip: After turning it on, it is linked to the control mode below. The control mode is ON, and the normally open contacts will become normally closed during the period. Normally open contacts remain disconnected outside of the time period. The control mode is OFF, and the normally closed contact will become normally open during the period of time. Normally closed contacts remain closed outside of the time period. The control mode is AUTO, and the normally open and normally closed contacts are triggered according to the following settings. Once set, the time control function does not work.
energy_empty_rule_tips: Please select according to the actual circuit breaker specifications on the grid side of the inverter. If the specification is incorrectly filled in, it may cause the circuit breaker to trip.
generator_enable_before_shutdown: Diesel Generator turned on before PCS Shutdown
generator_tip: If diesel generator is connected to the energy storage system, please switch on the 'Generator' switch and fill in the parameters.
grid_consum_power_upper_limit: Max. Power through the Meter: the upper limit of Grid Consumption Power
install_mode_tip: AC: refers to the photovoltaic transformation system, there is a photovoltaic inverter on site and on the power grid, and the photovoltaic module is connected to the photovoltaic inverter, not directly connected to the energy storage inverter; DC: For the site where the hybrid inverter is installed, it refers to the new photovoltaic system, and the photovoltaic modules are directly connected to the inverter; For the site where the battery inverter is installed, there is no photovoltaic inverter on site, the battery inverter is only integrated into the power grid, and only the power grid can charge the battery.Hybrid: This refers to a situation where there is a photovoltaic inverter connected to the grid on site, and photovoltaic modules are also directly connected to the hybrid inverter.
inverter_installed_capacity_tip: Total installed PV capacity connected to PV inverter
io_expansion_module: Is there an IO Expansion Module
l2_policy_execution_minimum_soc: L2 policies execute the minimum SOC
max_current_limit_tips: This setting represents the maximum current from the grid allowed for each phase.
max_feed_in_pv_ratio_hint: The ratio of max. feed-in power to PV installed capacity (including all PV capacity connected to PV-inverter and energy storage inverter).
max_grid_charge_tooltip: Max. Grid Charging Power: the upper limit of AC-side Charging Power of the Forced Charging functions (SOC Directional Calibration, SOC Automatic Calibration, Undervoltage Forced Charging, and Charging Time Periods)
max_grid_draw_current_enable: The maximum current limit for the household side to draw electricity from the grid
micro_load_power_support_tip: After this function is enabled, when the load power is low (within 50 W), the battery is forced to discharge continuously to avoid abnormal power supply to small loads caused by inverter accuracy issues under certain operating conditions.
one_click_shut_down_tip: After this function is enabled, the system records the serial number on the cloud platform and marks it as lost, remotely locking the machine; The only way to unlock it is through Watery After-Sales, while users need to provide seller and invoice details, as well as paperwork proving the theft of the property. After the one-button shutdown is turned on, the PV input and battery charge and discharge will be automatically stopped, and the power cannot be taken from the grid to supply the load through AC bypass. Remote anti-theft, when the machine is lost, the serial number of the stolen machine can be fed back to the after-sales.
power_supply_method_tip: Battery charging power mode: When this mode is selected, the inverter draws power from the diesel engine = the set battery charging power value, but if the value of (diesel engine rated power * diesel engine available power percentage – load side power of the inverter) is less than the set battery charging power value, then the inverter draws power from the diesel engine according to the value of (diesel engine rated power * diesel engine available power percentage – load side power of the inverter); Diesel Engine Rated Power Mode: When this mode is selected, the power of the inverter draws power from the diesel engine = the rated power of the diesel engine * the percentage of available power of the diesel engine – the load side power of the inverter – the PV side power of the inverter, if it is calculated as a negative value, the inverter does not draw power from the diesel engine.
remote_lock_tip: When this function is turned on, the device will be marked as lost, the device will be locked and stop working, the only way to unlock it is to contact Waters after-sales unlock after preparing the purchase invoice and stolen certificate.
soc_set_tip: When the SOC is set to "at least" mode, the Aux contacts of the load need to be connected to the N/O points. When the battery SOC meets the actual set conditions (regardless of the set delay), the N/O point is off (load on) when the feed-in power is higher than the set "Switch on" power, and when the feed-input power is lower than the set "off" power or when the power supply is purchased, the N/O point is disconnected (load off). When the power supply is between the above two set data, no operation is performed. When the SOC is set to "at most" mode, the Aux contacts of the load need to be connected to the N/C points. When the battery SOC meets the actual set conditions (regardless of the set delay), when the feed power is higher than the set "Switch on" power, the N/C point closes (load on), and when the feed power is less than the set "off" power or the power supply is purchased, the N/C point is disconnected (load off). When the power supply is between the above two set data, no operation is performed.
storage_pv_tips: Total installed PV capacity connected to energy storage inverter
trigger_dry_aux_close: Trigger dry contact closure: When feed-in >
trigger_dry_aux_disconnect: Trigger dry contact disconnect: When feed-in <
vpp_scheduling_tip: VPP scheduling is supported when enabled, but VPP scheduling will not take effect after it is turned off
